implementation.provider: The registered Collector handler retains CollectorPullResult. The existing provider executor attaches run metadata while allowing the configured fetcher to retain the typed Collector result; default public callers still receive the same capped tuple. Other providers keep their tuple behavior.
implementation.configured_fetcher: Passes the acknowledged scheduler watermark into the existing Collector request unless an explicit watermark is configured; propagates next_cursor, verified empty outcome and observed fields into IngestBatch. Persists the Collector outcome in the existing configured fetch-state JSONL, including degraded empty/pause reasons. Transport and verification failure replace a previous healthy outcome with degraded/unverified truth and preserve the real last_error. Static allow_empty cannot override Collector evidence.
implementation.no_new_data_proof: Zero returned records, no pending bundle or partial cursor, complete sweep, no feature rejection, healthy recognized host status with last_run_at exactly matching the latest consumed complete bundle, reverified manifest/hash declarations and item coverage over the existing guarded transport, and an identical locally stored verified manifest plus every previously verified raw file. A bare supplied cursor or initial missing bundles cannot establish success. No raw network reads are added to the consumed-boundary check.
implementation.cursor_fencing: Ordered verification stops at paused or partial bundles. A paused bundle never advances the cursor; partial bundle consumption retains an item-offset cursor and prevents later bundles from being skipped. Existing cap, durable adapter resume and idempotent tuple replay remain in place.
implementation.contradictions: Manifest/index status and finished_at must agree; malformed source entries and unknown, unavailable, paused or failed source status cannot qualify a healthy empty result.
implementation.existing_owner_paths: No artifact-contract extension was needed. Changes stay in the three declared source files, two declared test files and this manifest. Existing runtime readback already exposes configured fetch_state; existing scheduler, pipeline, source health, receipt and persistence implementations remain unchanged.
